vis_skeleton_2d_coco: draw a COCO 17-joint 2D skeleton on an image from 2D keypoints
vis_skeleton_2d_openpose25: draw an OpenPose 25-joint 2D skeleton on an image from 2D keypoints
vis_bbox_xywh: draw a bounding box on an image given x, y, width, height coordinates
vis_cocoskeleton: draw a COCO 17-joint skeleton with colored keypoints and limb connections on an image
imshow: display an image in an OpenCV window with optional scaling and RGB to BGR conversion
